issues.explanation: Method has no return type after colon so the file is a PHP parse error and nothing using the model can run.
Controllers check only the preset current join and never intersect with the JWT queues claim stored as jwt_queues, so a token restricted to one queue can list and issue tickets for any preset queue.
No controller compares the {entity} slug to the token entity, so a token for entity A can call entity B endpoints instead of getting 403 forbidden.
Queue is bound globally by slug with no scoping to the entity and no queue_not_found 404 handling, so another entity slug resolves instead of 404.
Pairing does a non-locked read then a separate transaction that only saves, so two concurrent POSTs with the same code can both succeed and create two totems.
Diff adds no tests directory files despite new command, auth endpoint, three authenticated endpoints, middleware and CORS behavior.
Throttle middleware is attached but there is no exception rendering for api/* to 429 {code:rate_limited}, so Laravel default throttle response is returned.

CORS prefix check with stripos allows http://localhost.evil.com and preflight echoes any Origin while real API routes lack cors middleware and send Access-Control-Allow-Credentials false instead of omitting it.
Totem creation omits last_seen_at even though the task requires active plus last_seen_at now on pairing success.
Queues list returns stored visual verbatim and priorities return empty visual arrays with no 1-based visual.order injection and no color/icon shape.
Required Entity::totems and Entity::totemPresets relations, docs updates to docs/api/totem.md plus database-schema and architecture, and failure audit logging are absent from the diff.
phpunit.xml secret test_secret_32_chars_long_here_ is 31 chars not at least 32 and .env.example uses a __GENERATED_SECRET__ placeholder with no real default handling.
Pairing success uses Log::info and failure is never logged, with no evidence of the project audit channel required by logging conventions.
Priority list is hardcoded twice plus priorityLabels helper, JWT header/payload is base64-encoded twice, and unused TicketStatus and InactiveQueueException imports remain.
New app/Http/Kernel.php and app/Console/Kernel.php scaffold legacy kernel classes that modern Laravel bootstrapping does not use, adding dead indirection for registration.

conventions.evidence: Uses IssueTicket action and reversible migrations per app/Http/Controllers/TotemApiController.php:165 and database/migrations/2026_10_29_000001_create_totems_table.php:46, but ships no tests, no docs sync, Log::info instead of audit per app/Console/Commands/PairTotemCode.php:48, and #[Fillable] attribute vs $fillable per app/Models/Totem.php:11.

readability.evidence: Names and small methods are clear per app/Http/Controllers/TotemApiController.php:99, but dead imports, duplicated priority literals, and broken active(): at app/Models/TotemPreset.php:34 require effort to maintain.

requirements.evidence: Broken app/Models/TotemPreset.php:34 parse error; missing JWT-queues intersection at app/Http/Controllers/TotemApiController.php:103, missing entity 403 and queue 404 scoping at routes/api.php:13, non-atomic pairing at app/Http/Controllers/TotemAuthController.php:227, missing rate_limited rendering, CORS, visual.order, last_seen_at, Entity relations and docs.

scope.evidence: Most hunks serve pairing, JWT, totem endpoints and migrations, with only the extra app/Http/Kernel.php:1 and app/Console/Kernel.php:1 scaffolding as unnecessary but small.

security.evidence: JWT queues claim ignored at app/Http/Controllers/TotemApiController.php:103, entity mismatch unchecked, global queue binding at routes/api.php:13, raceable pairing at app/Http/Controllers/TotemAuthController.php:227, and prefix CORS bypass at app/Http/Middleware/Cors.php:352 with hash_equals correctly used at app/Http/Middleware/TotemAuth.php:436.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses IssueTicket per app/Http/Controllers/TotemApiController.php:165, but duplicates priority arrays at lines 136 and 180, double-encodes JWT at app/Http/Controllers/TotemAuthController.php:269, leaves unused imports, and hand-rolls JWT plus legacy Kernels.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/* or Pest files; only app/, config/, database/factories, database/migrations, phpunit.xml, routes/api.php and .env.example are touched.

review.summary: Adds totem pairing, JWT auth, scoped queue/priority/ticket endpoints, CORS and migrations, but the preset model has a parse error and queue/entity scoping, atomic pairing, throttle rendering, CORS and docs are missing or wrong. No tests ship and JWT-scope bypass plus race and CORS prefix flaws make it unmergeable, so it needs substantial rework.
